origin.says: 方 (square, side) is the sound and also helps the meaning 'side'. The top part's meaning is unclear and changed shape many times over history.
米 (rice) for the meaning plus 羔 (lamb) as the sound: a cake made from rice flour.
Simplified from 軌: 车 (cart) for the meaning plus 九 (nine) as the sound: the space between cart wheels, the rut; hence track, rail, path.

ety.hint: Resembling 肖 grain 禾; 肖 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 禾 (grain) for the meaning plus 肖 as the sound: first the tip of a grain stalk, hence 'a little, slightly'.
Simplified from 憐: 心 (heart) for the meaning plus 粦 (will-o'-the-wisp) as the sound. The simplified form uses ⺖ (heart) with 令 (command) as the new sound part: to pity.
𥫗 (bamboo) for the meaning plus 相 (mutual) as the sound: a bamboo box, a chest or trunk.
㫃 (a flag on a pole, written 方 with 𠂉 on top) for the meaning plus 其 (basket) as the sound, placed under the flag: a banner, a flag.

碎.def: to break, to smash; broken, busted

origin.says: 石 (stone) for the meaning plus 卒 (soldier) as the sound: smashed stone, broken to pieces.

碎.name: shatter

origin.says: 木 (tree) for the meaning plus 昜 as the sound: a poplar or willow. Simplified from 楊, with 昜 written in the cursive shape 𠃓.

赴.def: to attend, to go to, to be present

origin.says: 走 (run) for the meaning plus 卜 (divine) as the sound: to hurry to a place, to attend.

赴.name: head for

origin.says: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 也 (also) as the sound: a pool or pond.

逮.def: to catch, to seize; to arrive, to reach

origin.says: 辶 (walking) for the meaning plus 隶 (to catch) as the sound and meaning: to chase and catch up with, to arrest.

逮.name: arrest

origin.says: 疒 (sickness) for the meaning plus 役 (service) shortened to 殳 as the sound: a sickness that spreads through all, an epidemic.

ety.hint: Money 贝 used to raise an army 武; 武 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: Simplified from 賦: 貝 (shell, money) for the meaning plus 武 (military) as the sound: money levied, a tax (first for the army); also to bestow. 貝 is written 贝.

惑.def: to confuse, to mislead; to doubt

ety.hint: An uncertain 或 heart 心; 或 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 心 (heart) for the meaning plus 或 (or, perhaps) as the sound and hint: a heart unsure which way, confused, in doubt.

惑.name: confused

尺.def: ruler, tape-measure; unit of length, about 1 ft.

ety.hint: Picture of a man measuring by pacing

origin.says: Origin uncertain: one reading a person with a mark on the leg at one foot's height, another a hand spread out to measure. It means a foot-long ruler, a measure.

尺.name: ruler

ety.hint: Sunlight 日 and children 子 in a building 厂

origin.says: 厂 (cliff, cave) plus a drawing of a jug: wine left to age in a cave grows strong and rich, hence thick, deep, generous. The jug part now looks like 日 (sun) over 子 (child).

丁.def: male adult; robust, vigorous; 4th heavenly stem

origin.says: A drawing of a nail seen from above or the side; the nail sense is now written 釘 (nail). The character was borrowed for 'adult man' and a calendar sign. One reading sees a head instead.

丁.name: nail
丁.in: 行打停街厅订顶宁灯衡钉盯衔柠衍叮衙拧亭狞泞

ety.hint: Someone 亻 who lights the way 昌; 昌 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 亻 (person) for the meaning plus 昌 (flourishing) as the sound: one who leads the singing, to lead, to advocate.

宇.def: building, house, room, structure; space, the universe

origin.says: 宀 (roof, house) for the meaning plus 于 (at) as the sound: the eaves of a house, then the dwelling, and widened to space, the universe.

宇.name: universe

origin.says: A kneeling figure (the left part, now shaped like 苟 grass + phrase) plus 攵 (hand with a stick, authority): kneeling with care before authority, to respect.

糟.def: sediment, dregs; to waste, to spoil

origin.says: 米 (rice) for the meaning plus 曹 (officials) as the sound: the dregs left from rice wine, hence 'rotten, messed up'.

糟.name: dregs

origin.says: From 廈: 广 (building) for the meaning plus 夏 (summer, also 'great') as sound and meaning: a great building, a mansion. The simplified form swaps 广 for 厂 (cliff shelter).

洁.def: clean, pure; to purify, to cleanse

origin.says: Stands for 潔: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 絜 as the sound: clean. Simplification used the old variant 洁, whose sound part is the simpler 吉 (lucky).

洁.name: spotless

origin.says: 彗 (broom) as the sound plus 心 (heart, mind) for the meaning: a bright, clever mind.
讠 (speech) for the meaning plus 荒 (wasteland) as the sound: empty, false words, a lie. Simplified from 謊 (言 → 讠).
Traditional 廁: 广 (building) for the meaning plus 則 (rule) as the sound: the toilet room. The simplified form writes 广 as 厂 (cliff) and 則 as 则.
Stands for 膚 (skin), built on 肉 (flesh) with an abbreviated sound part. Simplification used the old variant 肤: 月 (flesh) plus 夫 (man) as the sound.

裂.def: to split, to rend; crevice, crack

origin.says: 衣 (clothes) for the meaning plus 列 (row; also 'to tear') as the sound: cloth torn apart, to split or crack.

裂.name: split

洛.def: a river in the Shanxi province; a city

origin.says: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 各 (each) as the sound: the name of a river, and the city Luoyang on it.

洛.name: luo river

ety.hint: A person walking over 彳 with food in hand 殳

origin.says: 彳 (going) plus 殳 (spear in hand): going out with a weapon to guard the border, hence a duty, service, a laborer.

ety.hint: A sea shell, once used as currency

origin.says: Simplified from 貝, a picture of a cowrie shell, once used as money. 贝 is its cursive shape.

贝.name: shell money
贝.in: 员资则费质责负赛财测购败货赢损贵贸惯贴赚绩遗赞贡贫账锁赏赌贷赖贯债圆愤赋厕婴贪溃贼赔侦侧贩喷懒贺贬樱赁馈贿赂勋赠坝琐赎鹦

伯.def: older brother; father's elder brother; sir, sire, count

origin.says: 亻 (person) for the meaning plus 白 (white) as the sound: the eldest brother, then father's elder brother, uncle.

伯.name: uncle

ety.hint: A man walking 夂 on ice ⺀

origin.says: Origin unclear. The modern form reads as 夂 (foot) above ⺀ (ice): walking on ice in the cold season. Early forms may have drawn the knotted end of a cord (the end of the year); one reading links it to an insect drawing.

储.def: to save money, to store, to reserve; heir

origin.says: 亻 (person) for the meaning plus 诸 (various) as the sound: to store up, to keep in reserve. Simplified from 儲 (言 written 讠).

储.name: store up

珍.def: a treasure, a precious thing; rare, valuable

origin.says: 𤣩 (jade) for the meaning plus 㐱 (thick hair) as the sound: a rich, precious gem, hence a treasure and rare.

珍.name: precious gem

ety.hint: One with little 幺 strength 力; 幺 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 幺 (tiny) plus 力 (strength): one with little strength, a young child. 幺 may also give the sound.

塞.def: to stop up, to seal, to cork, to block; pass, frontier; fortress

origin.says: 宀 (house) with 工-like items and 廾 (two hands): stuffing things into a space, 𡨄; 土 (earth) was added for sealing it with clay. Hence to stop up, to block, and a frontier fortress.

塞.name: plug up

闹.def: busy, lively; to dispute, to quarrel

ety.hint: As busy as the market 市 gate 门

origin.says: Simplified from 鬧: 鬥 (fighting) plus 市 (market): fights and markets are noisy. The simplified form replaces 鬥 with the look-alike 门 (door).

闹.name: noisy

ety.hint: A beast's 豸 appearance 皃; 皃 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: First written 皃, a drawing of a face; 豸 (beast), cut from 豹 (leopard), was added as the sound. Hence 'looks, appearance'.
刂 (knife) for the meaning plus 佥 (all) as the sound: a double-edged sword. Simplified from 劍 by shortening 僉 to 佥.
⺖ (heart) for the meaning plus 尤 (especially) as the sound: worry, grief. It replaces 憂, which once showed a head and hand covering the face in sorrow, with 心 (heart) added later.

闲.def: fence, guard; to defend; idle time

ety.hint: A wooden fence 木 with a door 门

origin.says: Simplified from 閑: wood (木) across a gateway (門), a barrier or fence; borrowed for 'idle', standing for 閒 (leisure). 門 is written 门.

闲.name: idle

ety.hint: To connect 丩 threads 纟; 丩 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: Simplified from 糾: 糸 (silk) for the meaning plus 丩 (two entwined cords) as the sound and meaning: to entangle; hence to correct, to investigate. 糸 is written 纟.

ety.hint: A tiger 虍 standing on a rock 几; 虍 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: A drawing of a tiger set upright: 虍 is the head with open jaws, and the body, legs and tail shrank to the 几 shape below.
氵 (water) for the meaning plus 永 (long) as the sound: moving through water, to swim. 永 itself may once have drawn a person in flowing water.
扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 崔 (lofty) as the sound: to break down, to destroy.

滚.def: to boil, to roll, to turn

origin.says: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 袞 (imperial robe) as the sound: water rolling and boiling. Simplified from 滾 with the sound part written 衮.

滚.name: roll boil

摸.def: to caress, to stroke, to gently touch

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 莫 (do not) as the sound: to feel or stroke with the hand.

摸.name: feel by hand

ety.hint: A formation 阝of soldiers 车

origin.says: 阝 (mound, place) with 車 (chariot): chariots drawn up in a place, battle formation. It derives from an older form with 東 and 攴. Simplified from 陣, with 车 for 車.
穴 (hole, cave) plus 囱 (lattice opening) as sound and meaning: an opening in the wall that lets light in, a window. 穴 was added once 囱 came to mean chimney.

谐.def: to joke, to jest; to harmonize, to agree

origin.says: Simplified from 諧: 言 (speech) for the meaning plus 皆 (all) as the sound: words in agreement, harmony, and also joking. 言 (speech) is written in its short form 讠.

谐.name: in tune

拼.def: to link, to join together; to incorporate

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 并 (combine) as the sound and hint: to piece together by hand; also to risk all.

拼.name: piece together

origin.says: 宀 (roof) for the meaning plus 由 (from) as the sound: the roof beam, then the sky as a roof over all, time and space.
origin.src: Dong Chinese; MakeMeAHanzi; own knowledge for the beam

origin.says: 耳 (ear) for the meaning plus 甹 (quick, light) as the sound: to make inquiries, to send an envoy, then to hire and to betroth.
Simplified from 緣: 糸 (silk) for the meaning plus 彖 (a pig) as the sound: the hem along a garment's edge, then cause, fate. Only the silk radical became 纟.

撞.def: to bump into, to collide, to hit, to knock against

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 童 (child) as the sound: to strike, bump into.

撞.name: collide

ety.hint: Simplified form of 孫; a chain 系 of descent 子

origin.says: Simplified from 孫, 子 (child) + 系 (continuing line): the child further down the line, a grandchild. 系 was replaced by 小 (small): a small child.
革 (leather) for the meaning plus 圭 (jade tablet) as the sound: leather shoes, then any shoes.

ety.hint: A bird 隹 getting its tail singed 灬

origin.says: 隹 (bird) over 灬 (fire): read as a bird being roasted, hence scorched, burnt, and anxious. One reading says the bottom was first 小 (small) as a sound part and only later became fire.
Simplified from 閣 (門 became 门): 门 (door) for the meaning plus 各 (each) as the sound: a pavilion, a chamber; also a cabinet of ministers.

挣.def: to struggle, to strive, to endeavor

ety.hint: To fight 争 by hand 扌; 争 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: From 掙: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 爭 (struggle) as the sound: to struggle, to earn by effort. 爭 was shortened to 争.

挣.name: struggle free

origin.says: From 爺: 父 (father) for the meaning plus 耶 (a question particle) as the sound, an elder male, grandpa. Simplification replaced the sound part 耶 with a small seal-like shape.
From 齊, a picture of grain heads or fruits standing in neat, even rows: even, uniform. The simplified form is an old informal shorthand of the whole character.
土 (earth) for the meaning plus 矣 (old particle) as the sound: fine dust; now also the Angstrom unit.
亻 (person) for the meaning plus 扁 (flat) as the sound: leaning to one side, slanted, biased.
The traditional 艱 put a clay-and-drought part on the left and 艮 (stubborn) as the sound: hard going, difficult. The simplified form swaps the complex left part for the plain mark 又 (hand).

ety.hint: An offering 土 in your hand 寸

origin.says: Originally a hand (又, later 寸) with a foot-sign (之, go) as the sound, meaning 'to hold' (now 持). The foot-sign later turned into 土 (earth). 'Temple, court' is a borrowed use.

番.def: to take turns, to repeat; to sow; a turn

ety.hint: Sowing seeds 米 on the farm 田

origin.says: One reading: 釆 (to tell apart) as the sound plus 田 (field). An older reading sees an animal's paw print; another, seeds spread from a hand (sowing). Now 'a turn, a time' and 'foreign'.

番.name: taking turns

origin.says: Simplified from 欄: 木 (wood) for the meaning plus 闌 as the sound, replaced by 兰: a wooden railing or fence; also a column in print.
䖵 (insects, two 虫 (bug)) for the meaning plus 春 (spring) as the sound: bugs wriggling in spring, hence clumsy, sluggish, stupid.

纵.def: to indulge in, to give free reign to

origin.says: Simplified from 縱: 糸 (thread, now 纟) for the meaning plus 從 (follow) as the sound, now 从: letting the thread run loose, to let go, to indulge.

纵.name: let loose

阴.def: the female principle; dark, shaded; hidden, implicit, secret

ety.hint: The place 阝 of the moon 月; compare 阳

origin.says: From 陰: 阜 (hill) for the meaning plus 侌 (cloudy) as the sound, the shady side of a hill. The simplified form replaces 侌 with 月 (moon), an old variant.

阴.name: shady side

挡.def: to block, to obstruct; to get in the way; cover, guard

ety.hint: A hand 扌 raised at the right time 当; 当 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: From 擋: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 當 (to face) as the sound: to block. 當 was shortened to 当.

挡.name: fend off

聪.def: sharp (of sight and hearing); intelligent, clever, bright

origin.says: 耳 (ear) for the meaning plus 悤 as the sound, now written 总: keen of hearing, hence clever. Simplified from 聰.

聪.name: sharp ears

ety.hint: A cart 车 carried on one's shoulder 舁

origin.says: 車 (cart) for the meaning plus 舁 (lift with four hands) as the sound, which wraps around it: a carried carriage, a sedan chair. Simplified from 輿 (車 → 车).
忄 (heart) for the meaning plus 感 (feel) as the sound: a feeling left in the heart, regret.
